gymnastĭcus , a, um, adj., = γυμναστικός,
I.of or belonging to bodily exercise, gymnastic (Plautinian, for which Cic. uses gymnicus): “pro exercitu gymnastico et palaestrico hoc habemus,” Plaut. Rud. 2, 1, 7 : “arte gymnastica, disco, hasta, pila,” id. Most. 1, 2, 72 (a spurious line).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
